Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 90. Category: form. Red Eye.

Transformation
You have awakened the power of Ceralians in both of
your eyes.
Increase your Power by 5
You gain a +3 to all Wisdom (Perception) checks
The range of all Standard Ki Attacks and Ki
Techniques is doubled
Your Critical Threat Range increases by 2
At the end of your turn, you lose 5 Stamina
Gained at Level 15
